title: Responsible Multilingual Large Language Models: A Survey of Development, Applications, and Societal Impact

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and comparing subword fertility rates, tokenizer vocabulary efficiency, and inference costs across different languages (high-resource vs. low-resource) to quantify representational disparity and structural bias toward English and other high-resource languages.

Reviewing and synthesizing qualitative differences in how language models handle cultural identity, common sense, and ethical norms across different languages, noting hallucination phenomena when models are forced to apply high-resource language cultural norms to other languages.
